title: Sidebar Overlay WebContentsView
notes: Implements true sidebar overlay using multiple WebContentsViews with z-ordering. Solves fundamental Electron constraint where WebContentsView renders above HTML content.

drift_resolved.description: The spec defines a comprehensive SidebarOverlayService with animation methods (animateBounds, smooth slide transitions with 250ms duration and ease-out cubic curves), but the actual implementation appears to have different animation handling and additional features like mouse tracking and instant hide functionality not specified.

The actual implementation includes mouse tracking functionality for auto-show behavior (10px left edge trigger) and instant hide methods that are not documented in the specification. The test files show features like `hideInstant`, mouse tracking, and focus change action handling.

The actual implementation includes error handling patterns in IPC handlers (returning success/error responses) and WebContents lifecycle management (isDestroyed checks) that are not specified in the original spec.
The actual implementation includes floating mode configuration (`setFloatingMode`) and mode-specific behavior that goes beyond the basic show/hide functionality described in the spec.

The test files reference commits and regression prevention notes (like "Commit 17fa3d0", "Commit 06130e5", "Commit f936462") that indicate significant implementation details not reflected in the original specification.
